default.description: No secrets, no cluster access; internet, DNS and pi-sync only.

operator.description: Infra only: cluster-admin, ghcr + platform secrets via operator-env (mise run selfhost:platform:pi-ez-operator:env:apply), open egress.

labrat.description: labrat only: an OpenShell sandbox with Claude through the gateway, read-only cluster access through the labrat-kube relay, read-only Prometheus and Loki, and the Seerr, ROMarr and Questarr APIs with keys held by the gateway (labrat-seerr, labrat-romarr, labrat-questarr), and read-only access to the bry-guy/infra repository with a token held by the gateway (labrat-github). No GitHub write access, no other network.
